name: Cavrequench
body:
Cavrequench CR 17

XP 102,400
Advanced elder fire elemental druid 11
NE Huge outsider (elemental, extraplanar, fire)
Init +15; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +30

DEFENSE

AC 34, touch 20, flat-footed 22 (+11 Dex, +1 dodge, +14 natural, -2 size)
hp 364 (27 HD; 11d8+16d10+227)
Fort +25, Ref +24, Will +17; +4 vs. fey and plant-targeted effects; DR 10/—; Immune elemental traits, fire; Resist cold 10
Weaknesses vulnerability to cold

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft.
Melee frost brand +35/+30/+25/+20 (4d6+18/17-20 plus 1d6 cold) or 2 slams +28 (2d8+5 plus burn)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks burn (2d10 fire, DC 26), wild shape 4/day
Domain Spell-like Abilities (CL 11th; concentration +14)

6/day—icicle (1d6+5 cold)

Druid Spells Prepared (CL 11th; concentration +14)

6th—cone of cold D (DC 20), wall of stone
5th—baleful polymorph (DC 18), ice storm D, transmute rock to mud
4th—control water D, dispel magic (2), geyser (DC 17)
3rd—aqueous orb (DC 16), cup of dust (DC 16), daylight, hydraulic torrent, sleet storm, water breathing D
2nd—barkskin, bear’s endurance, chill metal (DC 16), fog cloud D, resist energy, spider climb
1st—cure light wounds (2), faerie fire, hydraulic push, obscuring mist D, produce flame
0th (at will)—detect magic, flare (DC 13), guidance, resistance

D Domain spell; Domain Water

STATISTICS

Str 30, Dex 33, Con 22, Int 14, Wis 17, Cha 15
Base Atk +24; CMB +36 (+38 sunder); CMD 58 (60 vs. sunder)
Feats Blind-Fight, Combat Casting, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Elemental Focus (cold), Furious Focus, Improved Critical (greatsword), Improved InitiativeB, Improved Sunder, Iron Will, Lightning Stance, Mobility, Power Attack, Spring Attack, Weapon FinesseB, Wind Stance
Skills Acrobatics +39 (+51 to jump), Climb +29, Escape Artist +39, Intimidate +32, Knowledge (nature) +30, Knowledge (planes) +21, Perception +30, Sense Motive +28, Spellcraft +21, Survival +5
Languages Aquan, Common, Druidic, Ignan
SQ nature bond (Water domain), nature sense, trackless step, wild empathy +13, woodland stride
Gear frost brand
Base Statistics Without barkskin or bear’s endurance, Cavrequench’s statistics are: AC 30, flat-footed 18; hp 310; Fort +23; Special Attacks burn (2d10 fire, DC 24).
